categories.name: Allies
categories.description: The army may have Early Polish Allies

units.name: General
units.description: Rides a horse.

units.name: Captain
units.description: Rides a horse.

units.name: Knights and Nobles
units.description: Knight and Noble shave heavy armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. Shock Cavalry. May have cloth barding (+1) and lance (+1).

units.name: German or Bohemian Mercenary Knights
units.description: German or Bohemian Mercenary Knights have light armour, spear and shield.  Massed Cavalry. My have cloth barding (+1) and heavy armour (+1).

units.name: Horse Archers
units.description: Horse Archers have a bow. Inferior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Skirmishers. Nomad Cavalry. May have shield (+1).

units.name: Szeklers
units.description: Szekler have bow and shield. Evade. May have spear (+1) and light armour (+1).

units.name: Szeklers Skirmishers
units.description: Szekler Skirmishers have a bow. Skirmishers. Nomad Cavalry. May have spear (+1) and shield (+1).

units.name: Archer
units.description: Archers have a bow. Inferior Fighters. Open Order. May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of five points per base.

units.name: Armati
units.description: Armati have halberd and light armour. May have heavy armour (+1). May replace halberd with spear and shield (free).

units.name: Crossbowmen
units.description: Crossbowmen have light amrour and crossbow. Open Order. May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of nine points per base.

units.name: Levies
units.description: Levies have spear and shield. Inferior Fighters. Open Order. Levies.

lir_imperial_field_army.armyName: Late Imperial Roman (Imperial Field Army) 350 AD - 493 AD

categories.name: Allies & Mercenaries
categories.description: May take allies from the Gothic and Vandal Kingdoms list.

units.name: Magister
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Emperor
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Warlord
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Legate
units.description: May ride a horse,

units.name: Legate
units.description: May ride a horse,

units.name: Foederati
units.description: May ride a horse,

units.name: Catafractii/Clibanarii
units.description: Catafractii and Clibanarii have cataphract armour. May be Massed Cavalry (+1) May have kontos (+2) and bow (+1). Their horses may have full metal barding (+1). You may have one Catafractii Clibanarii unit for every two Eq units fielde in your army.uites

units.name: Equites
units.description: Equites have a spear, light  armour and shield. Light armour may be exchanged for heavy armour (+1). May have javelins (+1).

units.name: Illyricani Sagittarii
units.description: Equites have javelins and shield. Evade. Inferior Fighters.  They may have spear (+1) and any unit may repalce javelins with bow (free) to become Equites Sagitarri.. These may have light armour (+1) or they may be fielded as skirmishers.

units.name: Legionaries
units.description: Legionaries have a throwing spear, large shield and darts.  Shieldwall. They may have light armour (+2). They may exchange throwing spear for heavy throwing spear (+2). Legionary units may use Combined Formation with a quarter or half of the units figures exchnaging throwing spear, large shield and darts for bow and shield (-4) and forming the rear of thh unit. They may not take any other quipment. Veteran (+2)

units.name: Limitanei
units.description: Legionaries have a spear and large shield.  Inferior Fighters. Shieldwall. The may have darts (+2).

units.name: Auxillia
units.description: Auxillia have a throwing spear, large shield and darts. Open Order. Auxillia units may use Combined Formation with  a quarter or half of the units figures exchanging throwing spear, large shield and darts for bow and shield (-4 for each archer only bases) and forming the rear of the unit. Auxillia may be fielded as skirmishers at a points reduction of 33%.

units.name: Archers
units.description: Archers have bows and shields. Inferior Fighters. Open Order. Every second unit may exchange their bows for sling or javelins (free).

units.name: Heavy Cavalry
units.description: Heavy Cavalry have a spear and shield. Superior Fighters. May have light armour (+1) and javelins (+1).

units.name: Light Cavalry
units.description: Light Cavalry have bows. Nomad Cavalry. They may have shield (+1) and spear (+1). The may be fielded as skirmishers. For every two light cavalry units present one foederat Heavy Cavalry unit may be upgraded to Seppe Nobles (+2). Steppe Nobles Have bows.

units.name: Federate Infantry
units.description: Foederati Infantry have a throwing spear and shield. Warband. They may have heavy throwing spear (+2) or javelins(+2).
